# Run Pulse on your computer

1. Unzip the folder.
2. Make sure Python 3 is installed: <https://www.python.org/downloads/>
3. Double-click **START-PULSE.command** (macOS/Linux) or **START-PULSE.bat** (Windows).
4. Your browser opens **http://localhost:8787**.

Pulse runs only on your computer. The live Toronto weather theme needs an internet connection; everything else, including the arcade, works locally. It stores its archive in your user data folder, not in this folder. No account, ads, trackers or tunnel is used.

If the browser does not open, run `python3 run.py` in the folder and visit `http://localhost:8787`.
